title: Inspect and extend: Save choices and persist local identifiers
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/Models.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve projectstore, userdefaults keys, toggling, and backed/saved projections.
problem: Saving is a personal bookmark; backing is a local demo state. Trace both sets through UserDefaults and determine why a stored ID does not equal a real pledge. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/Models.swift` and the related project files: Sources/Models.swift; Sources/Screens/SavedView.swift; Sources/Screens/ProfileView.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to projectstore, userdefaults keys, toggling, and backed/saved projections.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Saved/backed IDs persist locally; changing pledge totals is sample in-memory state and does not sync.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Saving is a personal bookmark; backing is a local demo state. Trace both sets through UserDefaults and determine why a stored ID does not equal a real pledge.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/Models.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
